name: Mahatma Gandhi
quote: The spirit of democracy cannot be imposed from without. It has to come from within.

name: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
quote: In politics, hero-worship is a sure road to degradation and to eventual dictatorship.

name: Shaheed Bhagat Singh
quote: The sanctity of law can be maintained only so long as it is the expression of the will of the people.
